mapper.select: SELECT id, title, rent_cent AS rentCent FROM house_listing WHERE publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND is_special = 1 ORDER BY special_sort LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house_listing WHERE publish_status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM property_unit WHERE occupancy_status = 'VACANT'

SELECT u.nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.mobile, i.real_name AS realName, i.id_number_masked AS idNumberMasked, i.home_address AS homeAddress, i.company_name AS companyName, i.company_address AS companyAddress FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN tenant_identity_profile i ON i.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_favorite WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_browse_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO tenant_identity_profile(user_id, real_name, id_number_cipher, id_number_masked, mobile_cipher, mobile_hash, home_address, company_name, company_address, profile_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{tenantId}, #{request.realName}, SHA2(#{request.idNumber}, 256), CONCAT(LEFT(#{request.idNumber}, 3), '***********', RIGHT(#{request.idNumber}, 4)), #{request.mobile}, SHA2(#{request.mobile}, 256), #{request.homeAddress}, #{request.companyName}, #{request.companyAddress}, 'COMPLETED', NOW(3), NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE real_name=VALUES(real_name), id_number_cipher=VALUES(id_number_cipher), id_number_masked=VALUES(id_number_masked), mobile_cipher=VALUES(mobile_cipher), mobile_hash=VALUES(mobile_hash), home_address=VALUES(home_address), company_name=VALUES(company_name), company_address=VALUES(company_address), profile_status='COMPLETED', updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT u.nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.mobile, i.real_name AS realName, i.id_number_masked AS idNumberMasked, i.home_address AS homeAddress, i.company_name AS companyName, i.company_address AS companyAddress FROM sys_user u JOIN tenant_identity_profile i ON i.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{tenantId} AND u.role = 'TENANT' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment a WHERE a.tenant_id = u.id AND a.agent_id = #{agentId})
